t: Forge Steel locking pliers set is engineered for secure gripping and cutting performance across various trades. Contains a robust collection of 3 mixed pliers, each crafted from heat-treated chrome vanadium steel, providing exceptional durability and strength for demanding applications. The versatile set comprises 200mm long nose, 180mm combination, and 160mm diagonal pliers, ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general workshop tasks where precision and reliable hold are crucial. Ergonomic soft-grip TPR handles ensure comfortable operation and a firm grip, with enhanced control and reduced hand fatigue during extended use on building sites or in the workshop.
